normalization_rules: preserve Alerta_cb4, Alerta_amz1 and Alerta_cba as sensor-specific operational classes from the 2024 method edition
preserve Aviso as the documented final operational class without mapping it automatically to DESMATAMENTO_CR
do not treat operational classes as releases, assets, validation classes or metadata classname values
do not assign a final scientific meaning to the third documented type until its role in the table is unambiguously resolved
interpretation patterns are contextual aids for expert photointerpretation and not deterministic classifiers
preserve 48–72 hours as typical end-to-end processing latency, not a universal SLA
do not replace the separate nightly public publication and controlled enforcement access statements with the 48–72 hour latency
preserve the daily alert mask as a within-cycle operational exclusion mask, not a permanent land-cover class
do not collapse the DETER cycle mask into a PRODES accumulated deforestation mask
lack of PRODES confirmation does not by itself prove a DETER false positive
daily alert counts depend on image availability and season and should not be interpreted as homogeneous observation effort
promotion remains blocked until validation classes, crosswalks, current release, layer and asset are resolved
